verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly claims real-time bidirectional ERP sync that eliminates manual journal entries (ramp-docs-5). It also says coded transactions sync directly to the ERP (ramp-docs-15), and its directory lists broad native ERP connectors including NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Xero, Workday and Dynamics (ramp-intdir-1). Supporting signals include GL auto-coding (ramp-docs-2) and a syncable-transactions endpoint for accounting providers (ramp-supp-banking-api). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the bidirectional sync works (which objects flow back from the ERP, sync latency, conflict handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time behavior beyond marketing claims.
